description.en:
A^C SHEHR (.Ak Shehir, “the white 
town”; the ancient Philomelium) is the capital 
of a l^za of the province and san^ak of Konya, 
which comprises 2 nahiyes (Doghan Hisar, Djihan Beyli) and 90 village
description.tr: AKŞEHR (Ak Şehir, "beyaz şehir"; antik Philomelium), Konya vilayeti ve sancağında bir kazanın merkezi
